issues.description: The problem statement requires implementing check_status which must return a boolean (0 or 1) in EAX (problem_statement.md lines 21-22). The solution repository provides a check_status symbol but its implementation sets EAX to the address of the 'hello' data label (mov eax, hello) and returns that pointer (solution_repository/helloWorld.asm lines 6-8). Returning an address/pointer instead of a 0/1 boolean contradicts the specification and would confuse students and any automated tests that expect a boolean value in EAX.
issues.suggested_fix:
Change the implementation of check_status in solution_repository/helloWorld.asm so it places a boolean value (0 or 1) into EAX before returning. For example:

check_status:
    mov eax, 1    ; or mov eax, 0 depending on intended status
    ret

This makes the solution conform to the problem statement and ensures tests expecting 0/1 in EAX will pass.
